samples.question: Start at the ringed badge and trace the one connected route in increasing station-number order. The token has four states A, B, C, and D. The badge colors mean red=A, green=B, blue=C, and purple=D. At each station, a filled right triangle advances one state cyclically A-B-C-D-A, a filled left triangle retreats one state, and an outlined square leaves the state unchanged. Include the starting state and every state after stations 1 through 9 in the visited history. Which state is never visited? Answer A, B, C, or D.
